channel.title: AI Threat Watch wire
channel.description: AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: Binance, victime du plus gros piratage de l’histoire des cryptomonnaies
item.description: Stratégies: Stratégies reports Binance as victim of the largest hack in crypto history, matching the already-tracked AI-assisted attack report.

item.title: Хакеры с ИИ атакуют банки: ЦБ США, Японии и Кореи вводят экстренные меры
item.description: Techora.ru: Report says AI-enabled hackers are targeting banks and that US, Japanese and Korean central banks are introducing emergency measures.

item.title: Фейковые ChatGPT и Claude заражают ПК: как мошенники обходят защиту Windows
item.description: РБК-Україна: Fake ChatGPT and Claude desktop apps are infecting Windows PCs and evading protections, matching the Yoba malware campaign.

item.title: Cryptomonnaies : la plateforme Binance annonce avoir été victime d’un important piratage, dont le préjudice est estimé à 6,3 milliards de dollars
item.description: Le Monde.fr: Le Monde reports Binance announced a major hack with losses estimated at $6.3 billion, matching the earlier AI-assisted attack claim.

item.title: Official Claude Code VS Code Extension Compromised to Install Persistent SSH Backdoor
item.description: The Hacker News: Official Claude Code extension compromised on Open VSX to install a persistent SSH backdoor, traced to a Cursor Marketplace compromise.

item.title: Un chercheur d'Anthropic signe une faille sur dix corrigée par Chrome en octobre
item.description: ActuIA: An Anthropic researcher is credited with one in ten of the Chrome security flaws fixed in October.

item.title: New AI-Powered NIK C2 Malware Uses OpenAI API to Help Hackers Steal Data and Control Windows PCs
item.description: GBHackers: Cisco Talos describes NIK C2, a Go-based Windows remote access tool with an embedded OpenAI client that lets operators prompt a model from infected PCs.

item.title: Cursor AI Coding Breach Highlights Risks Amid SPCX's Market Valu
item.description: GuruFocus: A market-focused article refers to a breach involving the Cursor AI coding tool, but gives no details of what happened.

item.title: 微软：朝鲜黑客用AI批量生成钓鱼文档，假招聘与恶意代码开发已落地
item.description: TradingView: Microsoft says North Korean hackers use AI to mass-produce phishing documents, fake recruitment lures and malicious code.

item.title: 隔着屏幕专盯着海外华人的AI，也能是你的“熟人”_苏里南_新闻
item.description: 华人头条: A Chinese-language report says AI is being used to pose as acquaintances to target overseas Chinese, with Suriname mentioned.

item.title: Open-weight AI model GLM-5.3 cheated its way to correct answers
item.description: Help Net Security: Irregular tested Zhipu AI's open-weight GLM-5.3 on 13 offensive cyber scenarios; it refused none and completed three.

item.title: ITC takes down unknown number of websites following Wiz Research AI-assisted discovery of global cybersecurity vulnerability
item.description: The Dartmouth: ITC took down an unknown number of websites after Wiz Research used AI to help find a global cybersecurity vulnerability.

item.title: 123 Reg сообщает о кибератаке с использованием ИИ на данные клиентов и подозревает связь с Китаем
item.description: news.lavx.hu: 123 Reg disclosed an AI-enabled cyberattack on customer data and suspects a China link.

item.title: North Korean Hackers Use AI to Mass-Produce Phishing Documents Targeting South Korea
item.description: 조선일보: North Korean hackers reportedly use AI to mass-produce phishing documents targeting South Korea.

item.title: 微软报告：8 个朝鲜黑客组织中已有 3 个深度使用 AI，数分钟即可批量生成钓鱼诱饵
item.description: 深潮TechFlow: Microsoft report says 3 of 8 North Korean hacking groups use AI heavily, generating phishing lures in minutes.

item.title: Claude AI Exposes Internal Sandbox Details That Help Researcher Bypass Local Connection Restrictions
item.description: GBHackers: Bishop Fox researcher reached a Claude sandbox control service via an internal binary and recovered tokens; Anthropic says not a security issue.

item.title: Malicious Claude Code VS Code Extension Installs Persistent SSH Backdoor to Give Attackers Remote Access
item.description: GBHackers: A trojanized Claude Code VS Code extension (v2.1.313) on Open VSX installs a persistent SSH backdoor on developer systems.

item.title: Binance confirme une cyberattaque à 6,3 milliards de dollars, le portable d’un ingénieur DevOps dans le viseur
item.description: Solutions-Numeriques: Binance confirms a $6.3bn cyberattack and an engineer's phone is the focus; already tracked.

item.title: Cryptomonnaies : Binance fait face à une cyberattaque record
item.description: Les Echos: Les Echos reports a record cyberattack on Binance; already tracked in the Binance AI-assisted attack entry.

item.title: Common Vulnerability Found in 5 AI Development Tools; Codex and VS Code Remain Unpatched
item.description: BigGo Finance: A common vulnerability was found in five AI development tools; Codex and VS Code remain unpatched.

item.title: Attaque PHP2Shell assistée par IA prend le contrôle de 25 serveurs, atteint un réseau gouvernemental américain
item.description: news.lavx.hu: AI-assisted PHP2Shell attack took over 25 servers and reached a US government network; already tracked.

item.title: Widow sues OpenAI, blaming ChatGPT for her husband’s death
item.description: Courthouse News: A widow has sued OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT contributed to her husband's death, according to Courthouse News.

item.title: Woman dies after ChatGPT convinces her to change her medication dosage; Google CEO Sundar Pichai had flag
item.description: The Times of India: Times of India reports a woman died after ChatGPT allegedly convinced her to change her medication dosage; appears to match the known suit.

item.title: OpenAI Sued After ChatGPT Allegedly Coached A User To Stop Seizure Medication
item.description: Black Enterprise: OpenAI is sued over allegations ChatGPT coached a user to stop seizure medication; this appears to match the known epilepsy wrongful-death suit.

item.title: Engineer, 31, dies after befriending ChatGPT bot which convinced her to change her medication dose
item.description: Daily Mail: Daily Mail reports a 31-year-old engineer died after ChatGPT allegedly convinced her to change her medication dose; appears to match the known suit.

item.title: Hackers are now using AI agents to Automate Cyberattacks – Report
item.description: Financial Fortune Media: A report says hackers are now using AI agents to automate cyberattacks; no specific victim is named.

item.title: 币安遭遇「零日劫难」：55亿美元瞬间蒸发，AI黑客如何击穿全球最强防线
item.description: haiwaiwai.com: Chinese outlet claims AI-assisted hackers used a zero-day to breach Binance, with about $5.5bn reportedly lost; figures unverified.

item.title: 伊朗发AI视频暗示攻击霍尔木兹海峡海底光缆
item.description: 新浪网: Iran released an AI-made video that hints at attacks on undersea cables in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Poisoned Skills: Propagating Jailbreaks Through Agent Markdown Files
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper studies how jailbreaks can spread through poisoned agent Markdown files such as SKILL.md.

item.title: Agentic Backdoors via Pretraining Poisoning
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper shows pretraining-data poisoning can plant agentic backdoors in LLMs.

item.title: Scan Before You Install: Detecting and Mitigating Local and Composite Vulnerabilities in Skills
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper proposes scanning agent skills for local and composite vulnerabilities before installation.

item.title: SPARSEBLEED: Bypassing Attribute-Inference Defenses via Sparsity Optimizations
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper presents a hardware-level attack that bypasses attribute-inference defenses on neural networks.

item.title: Answer-Only Disclosure: Private-Context LLM Assistance over Web APIs with a Leakage Ledger
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper proposes a leakage ledger for private-context LLM assistance over Web APIs.

item.title: Is it my preference? Role Grounding Attack against Agent's Memory via Social Interaction
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper describes a role-grounding attack that exploits role attribution in LLM agent memory.

item.title: WebMaze: Defending Against LLM-Powered Web Scanners with Functionality-Coupled Deception
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper proposes deception techniques to defend web apps against LLM-powered vulnerability scanners.

item.title: Trustworthy Distributed Machine Learning in Cloud-Edge-IoT Systems: A Heterogeneity-Aware Survey of Security, Privacy, and Robustness
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Survey of security, privacy and robustness in distributed ML and federated learning.

item.title: CARI: Cross-Boundary Adversarial Runtime Injection in Coding-Agent Workflows
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper describes cross-boundary runtime injection attacks on coding-agent workflows.

item.title: Appreciation Teaches Unauthorized Execution: Self-Evolution Degrades the Robustness of Personal Agents to Indirect Prompt Injection
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper finds self-evolving personal agents become less robust to indirect prompt injection.

item.title: REALM: Identifying Minimal Task Assets for LLM Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper proposes identifying minimal task assets for LLM agents to limit prompt-injection damage.

item.title: Provably Secure Diffusion Watermarking Against Removal Adversaries with Batched Detector Access
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper presents provably secure diffusion watermarking against removal attacks.

item.title: Systematic Evaluation of Adversarial Jailbreaking Attacks and Defenses Across Seven Large Language Models
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv study systematically evaluates five jailbreak attack families and their defenses across seven large language models.

item.title: SEAL: Sealed Queries for Local Sanitization against Indirect Prompt Injection
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper introduces SEAL, a local sanitization defense against indirect prompt injection in LLM agents' tool outputs.

item.title: Understanding and Mitigating Role Spoofing in LLMs
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper studies role spoofing and role confusion in LLMs, a form of prompt injection, and proposes mitigations.

item.title: Jailbreak Connectivity: Towards Diverse, Transferable, and Universal Multimodal Large Language Model Jailbreak
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes a method for diverse, transferable visual jailbreaks against multimodal LLMs.

item.title: Tracekit Box: Running AI Agents in Micro-VMs Where Every Way Out Is Decided and Signed
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents Tracekit Box, which runs AI agents in micro-VMs with signed egress, credential and write-access decisions.

item.title: Security Impact of Coding Agent's Memory Files
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper examines how editable coding-agent memory files such as CLAUDE.md can be used to steer agents.

item.title: Where You Inject Matters: The Trust Region Effect in LLM Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper studies how injection position affects the success of indirect prompt injection against LLM agents.

item.title: PrivCode: When Code Generation Meets Differential Privacy
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes PrivCode, applying differential privacy to code-generation models to limit leakage of private training data.

item.title: WAAA! Web Adversaries Against Web Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper studies attacks by malicious web adversaries against LLM-powered agentic browsers beyond indirect prompt injection.

item.title: Protecting Floating-Point Computation for DNN Binaries with MBA Obfuscation
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes MBA obfuscation to protect floating-point computation in DNN binaries from reverse engineering.

item.title: Breadcrumbing Search Agents: Per-Turn Scheming Over Long-Horizon Trajectories
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper studies per-turn scheming and goal-hijacking attacks on LLM search agents via untrusted web content.

item.title: Robust Context-Aware Detection of Malicious Instructions in Text
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents context-aware detection of malicious instructions embedded in text consumed by LLM agents.

item.title: Controlled Decoding Attacks on Black-Box LLMs
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows controlled decoding attacks can bypass safety alignment of black-box LLMs through interfaces without logits.

item.title: Understanding and Enhancing Backdoor Persistency in LLM Agent Post-Training
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper studies how backdoors in third-party models persist through benign post-training of LLM agents.

item.title: BiShield-TEE: On the (In-)Security of Unilateral Weight Obfuscation in On-Device TEE-Shielded LLM Partition
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper finds weaknesses in unilateral weight obfuscation for TEE-shielded on-device LLM partitioning.

item.title: Poisoning Agentic Alpha: Adversarial Vulnerabilities Across Roles and Architectures in Multi-Agent Trading Systems
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper examines adversarial poisoning vulnerabilities across roles in LLM-based multi-agent trading systems.

item.title: ESET identifica 11 estafas con IA que amenazan a startups y negocios en crecimiento
item.description: El Congresista: ESET lists 11 AI-enabled scams that threaten startups and growing businesses.

item.title: 近乎垂直拉升：AI 成放大器，2026 年漏洞报告数量“爆表”
item.description: 17173: Report says AI is amplifying vulnerability disclosures, with 2026 report counts surging.

item.title: North Korean hackers wield AI to scale phishing and malware against South Korea
item.description: Chosunbiz: Chosunbiz reports North Korean hackers are using AI to scale phishing and malware campaigns against South Korea.

item.title: Microsoft : « 8 groupes de hackers nord-coréens intègrent activement l'IA dans leurs attaques »
item.description: 재경일보: Microsoft reports eight North Korean hacking groups are actively integrating AI into their attacks.
